g.text: Q+ is the state after the active clock edge. All outputs start0; edges at1,3,5,7. SR input pairs are10,00,01,10; JK pairs10,11,00,11; D inputs1,0,1,1.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Inputs are assumed stable through setup/hold intervals. The SR11 row is excluded from the waveform.
